job: Show a screenshot, video, diagram or a supplied picture in a captioned frame that can open larger.
purpose: A figure with a media area, an optional caption and a placeholder when there is no image yet. With data-zoom, activating the media opens a dialog with a copy of it. The 16:9 ratio is a preference: a placeholder that holds more grows to fit it. With data-fd-src it loads a supplied picture: the address passes safeImageUrl() first, the ratio is held, and a tile with an icon and a line stands in when there is none, it is refused or it fails.
useWhen: A docs page shows a screen of the product or a demo video.
A figure needs a caption and the option to look closer.
A person's own picture (a screenshot of a problem, an upload) is shown from an address the page does not control.

avoidWhen.when: An image inside a chat message.

states.name: zoomable
states.how: data-zoom; the media gets a zoom-in cursor

states.name: empty
states.how: data-state="empty"; data-fd-src is empty, so the tile says there is no picture

states.name: loading
states.how: data-state="loading" and aria-busy while the picture is requested; the ratio is already held

states.name: loaded
states.how: data-state="loaded"; the picture shows, and data-zoom works

states.name: failed
states.how: data-state="failed"; the address was allowed and the picture did not load

states.name: refused
states.how: data-state="refused"; the address failed safeImageUrl(), so nothing was requested

variants.useWhen: The reader may open the media in a dialog.
A 21:9 placeholder for a wide banner screenshot.
The frame loads a picture from an address; it is checked first.
A 4:3 frame for a photo or an upload.

parts.role: The image, video or placeholder; focusable when zoomable.
A play mark over a video placeholder.

keyboard.does: Opens a zoomable frame in a dialog.
